_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit as needed. Remove all _comment keys.

pan._comment: Pan motor – 28BYJ-48 via ULN2003. BCM GPIO pins: IN1=17, IN2=18, IN3=27, IN4=22

tilt._comment: Tilt motor – 28BYJ-48 via ULN2003. BCM GPIO pins: IN1=23, IN2=24, IN3=25, IN4=4

camera._comment: Arducam IMX477 Pi HQ Camera. index=0 maps to /dev/video0.

tracking._comment: deadband_px: pixel error below which no motor step is issued (jitter prevention).

mapping._comment: Enclosure: 25-inch wide L-shape with 8-ft (96-in) and 5-ft (60-in) legs.
